sources.label: Ticketmaster
sources.notes: Official Ticketmaster Discovery API v2. NO rows until TICKETMASTER_API_KEY is provisioned (free tier at developer.ticketmaster.com) and scripts/whatson/eventsRefresh.mjs runs. The moment the key lands, the disabled events-refresh workflow (or `npm run refresh:events`) fills this file with real London Music/Sports listings, each linking back to its ticketmaster.co.uk event page per Ticketmaster's attribution terms.

sources.label: Skiddle
sources.notes: Official Skiddle Events API (www.skiddle.com/api). NO rows until SKIDDLE_API_KEY is provisioned (free key on request) and eventsRefresh.mjs runs. London-strong grassroots/live-music coverage; each row links back to its skiddle.com event page per Skiddle's attribution/affiliate terms.
